info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Update API enables businesses to modify specific customer propositions based on the provided parameter. This endpoint allows for precise adjustments to customer data, enhancing personalized service offerings. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and CRM systems that require real-time updates to customer information. Operations are designed to improve customer experience and streamline management processes within banking services.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer proposition identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that the payload reflects the desired changes accurately.

requestBody.description: Updates the customer proposition details for the specified customer ID. Ensure that all required fields are populated based on the schema provided.

200.description: Request completed successfully, changes have been applied to the customer proposition.
